earlier.claim: The one-way directory check passes when the GCS listing fails. `rclone lsf ... "$src" $conf | sort > /tmp/src-dirs || exit 4` tests sort's status, not rclone's (the job's sh has no pipefail), so a failed GCS listing leaves /tmp/src-dirs empty, `comm -23` prints nothing and the run exits 0. The `|| exit 4` on that line and the `|| exit 3` on the SeaweedFS line can never fire. The exit-code table in the jobspec header and in docs/reference/gcs-backups.md promises 4 for a GCS listing failure. test_every_gcs_directory_must_exist_on_seaweedfs only checks that the text is present, so r1 stays green with the guard broken.

A dispatch with any bucket name that has no prefix under gcs:<bucket>/minio/ exits 0 with 'nothing to restore'. Exit codes are the operator's only signal, so a typo (`bucket=openvking`) or a backup that never ran reads the same as a successful restore. Refuse any name outside the four durable buckets with its own exit code. A durable bucket with no prefix can stay exit 0, as it does for models and datalake.
